author: Rory Robinson
title: Mark Cuban's 'really simple' reason for letting Jalen Brunson leave Mavericks - NewsBreak
text:
By Rory Robinson ,
1 hours ago Mark Cuban's biggest misstep was overlooking Jalen Brunson as he quietly rose to superstar status with the Dallas Mavericks. New York Knicks fans soon realized Dallas had already found their star before letting him walk.
Cuban discussed Brunson 's departure from the Mavericks and admitted that Dallas didn’t realize how good he would become before he left for New York and became one of basketball’s biggest stars.
Brunson led the Knicks to the 2026 title and won NBA Finals MVP, while the Mavericks missed the playoffs with just 26 wins. The Knicks guard has ascended to the rare status of being referred to by New Yorkers as the city's king. Meanwhile, Knicks fans bought championship merch at such a fast rate that NYC shattered Fanatics' all-time record .
• Knicks star's stance on White House visit as James Dolan accepts Donald Trump invitation
• Knicks owner set for awkward Zohran Mamdani face-off at New York parade
Letting Brunson leave in free agency looks more costly for Dallas each season, much like their big trade involving Luka Doncic . Cuban explained what the team was thinking at the time on the "House of Haymaker" show.
"It was really, really simple. We didn't see JB as what he would become," Cuban said. He went on to mention the period that should have changed how the team saw him.
"He showed that star potential when Luka got hurt, and he won those games against Utah for us but we were trying to get a star to put next to Luka, and JB's star had not risen yet."
Doncic strained his calf before the 2022 playoffs against the Utah Jazz. Brunson stepped up and led Dallas through the most important stretch of his career. Brunson scored 24 points in Game 1, then had a career-high 41 points with no turnovers and eight rebounds in Game 2.
He scored 31 in Game 3 on the road to help Dallas stay competitive until Doncic came back. The Mavericks beat the Jazz in six games and got their first playoff series win since 2011.
They later were swept in the Western Conference finals by the Golden State Warriors, but still passed on the chance to sign Brunson to a long-term deal. The Mavericks declined to offer him a four-year, $55 million extension.
By the time the organization came back around, Brunson's camp declined and elected to test unrestricted free agency. The Knicks moved quickly in July 2022, signing Brunson to a four-year, $104 million contract.
Brunson is now a three-time All-Star, three-time All-NBA Second Team pick, 2025 NBA Cup MVP, 2026 NBA champion and Finals MVP, plus one of the greatest Knicks of all time . The guard gave up about $113 million in salary to help the Knicks keep roster flexibility.
His decision allowed the organization to trade for Mikal Bridges and Karl-Anthony Towns and to sign OG Anunoby to an extension. Dallas is now entering a new era with reigning Rookie of the Year Cooper Flagg and the 9th overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft.
summary: 48 minutes ago Mark Cuban's biggest misstep was overlooking Jalen Brunson as he quietly rose to superstar status with the Dallas Mavericks. Cuban discussed Brunson 's departure from the Mavericks and admitted that Dallas didn’t realize how good he would become before he left for New York and became one of basketball’s biggest stars. Brunson led the Knicks to the 2026 title and won NBA Finals MVP, while the Mavericks missed the playoffs with just 26 wins.
